build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that creates a dynamic ball and static obstacles in a physics scene
create_gen_chain: create a function that generates spiral chains of 2D coordinates for obstacle placement
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball object to the PHYRE scene at a randomized center position
update_task_relationships: update the PHYRE task to require the ball touching the bottom wall using SpatialRelationship
set_solution_tier: set the PHYRE task metadata to SolutionTier.BALL for ball-stability diversification
